metadata.description: Phaladeepika Yogas, Additional Raja Yogas, Wealth Combinations, Karaka Yogas

subha_yoga_type1.name: Subha Yoga (Benefic Conjunction)
subha_yoga_type1.description: All three natural benefics (Jupiter, Venus, Mercury) in kendras or trikonas.

ashubha_yoga.name: Ashubha Yoga
ashubha_yoga.description: All three natural malefics (Sun, Mars, Saturn) in kendras afflicting.

adhiyoga_mercury.name: Adhi Yoga from Mercury
adhiyoga_mercury.description: Benefics in 6th, 7th, 8th from Mercury. Leadership in communication.

adhiyoga_lagna.name: Adhi Yoga from Lagna
adhiyoga_lagna.description: Benefics in 6th, 7th, 8th from Lagna. Health, partnership, and transformation blessed.

lagnadhi_yoga.name: Lagnadhi Yoga
lagnadhi_yoga.description: Jupiter, Mercury, Venus in 7th or 8th from lagna. Protection through partnerships.

chapa_yoga_benefic.name: Chapa Yoga (Benefic)
chapa_yoga_benefic.description: All benefics in lagna, 7th, and 4th or 10th. Bow of blessings.

ardha_chandra_benefic.name: Ardha Chandra Yoga (Benefic Moon)
ardha_chandra_benefic.description: Moon bright (Shukla Paksha) in kendra aspected by benefics. Half-moon blessings.

karaka_yoga_sun_10th.name: Karaka Yoga (Sun in 10th)
karaka_yoga_sun_10th.description: Sun (karaka for 10th) strong in 10th house. Natural significator in its house.

karaka_yoga_moon_4th.name: Karaka Yoga (Moon in 4th)
karaka_yoga_moon_4th.description: Moon (karaka for 4th) strong in 4th house. Emotional peace and property.

karaka_yoga_mars_3rd.name: Karaka Yoga (Mars in 3rd)
karaka_yoga_mars_3rd.description: Mars (karaka for 3rd) strong in 3rd house. Courage and siblings blessed.

karaka_yoga_mercury_4th.name: Karaka Yoga (Mercury in 4th)
karaka_yoga_mercury_4th.description: Mercury strong in 4th house. Education and intelligence blessed.

karaka_yoga_jupiter_2nd.name: Karaka Yoga (Jupiter in 2nd)
karaka_yoga_jupiter_2nd.description: Jupiter (karaka for wealth) strong in 2nd house. Natural wealth giver.

karaka_yoga_jupiter_5th.name: Karaka Yoga (Jupiter in 5th)
karaka_yoga_jupiter_5th.description: Jupiter (karaka for children) strong in 5th house. Children and wisdom blessed.

karaka_yoga_jupiter_9th.name: Karaka Yoga (Jupiter in 9th)
karaka_yoga_jupiter_9th.description: Jupiter (karaka for fortune) strong in 9th house. Fortune fully blessed.

karaka_yoga_venus_7th.name: Karaka Yoga (Venus in 7th)
karaka_yoga_venus_7th.description: Venus (karaka for marriage) strong in 7th house. Marriage blessed.

karaka_yoga_saturn_8th.name: Karaka Yoga (Saturn in 8th)
karaka_yoga_saturn_8th.description: Saturn (karaka for longevity) strong in 8th house. Long life blessed.

karaka_yoga_saturn_6th.name: Karaka Yoga (Saturn in 6th)
karaka_yoga_saturn_6th.description: Saturn strong in 6th house. Victory over enemies.

raja_lakshana_yoga.name: Raja Lakshana Yoga
raja_lakshana_yoga.description: 4 or more planets in exaltation or own signs. Royal characteristics.

panch_grahi_yoga.name: Panch Grahi Yoga
panch_grahi_yoga.description: Five planets in one sign. Intense concentration of energy.

shad_grahi_yoga.name: Shad Grahi Yoga
shad_grahi_yoga.description: Six planets in one sign. Extremely rare and powerful.

sapta_grahi_yoga.name: Sapta Grahi Yoga
sapta_grahi_yoga.description: Seven planets in one sign. Extraordinarily rare.

graha_malika_1_to_6.name: Graha Malika Yoga (1-6)
graha_malika_1_to_6.description: Planets forming chain from 1st to 6th house. Service-oriented garland.

graha_malika_2_to_7.name: Graha Malika Yoga (2-7)
graha_malika_2_to_7.description: Planets forming chain from 2nd to 7th house. Wealth-partnership garland.

graha_malika_3_to_8.name: Graha Malika Yoga (3-8)
graha_malika_3_to_8.description: Planets forming chain from 3rd to 8th house. Transformation garland.

graha_malika_4_to_9.name: Graha Malika Yoga (4-9)
graha_malika_4_to_9.description: Planets forming chain from 4th to 9th house. Fortune-property garland.

graha_malika_5_to_10.name: Graha Malika Yoga (5-10)
graha_malika_5_to_10.description: Planets forming chain from 5th to 10th house. Creative-career garland.

graha_malika_6_to_11.name: Graha Malika Yoga (6-11)
graha_malika_6_to_11.description: Planets forming chain from 6th to 11th house. Service-gains garland.

graha_malika_7_to_12.name: Graha Malika Yoga (7-12)
graha_malika_7_to_12.description: Planets forming chain from 7th to 12th house. Partnership-liberation garland.

graha_malika_8_to_1.name: Graha Malika Yoga (8-1)
graha_malika_8_to_1.description: Planets forming chain from 8th house through 12th to 1st. Transformation-rebirth garland.

kalasarpa_anuloma.name: Kala Sarpa Yoga (Anuloma)
kalasarpa_anuloma.description: All planets between Rahu and Ketu (Rahu to Ketu direction). Forward serpent.

kalasarpa_viloma.name: Kala Sarpa Yoga (Viloma)
kalasarpa_viloma.description: All planets between Ketu and Rahu (Ketu to Rahu direction). Reverse serpent.

partial_kalasarpa.name: Partial Kala Sarpa Yoga
partial_kalasarpa.description: Most planets between nodes but one or two outside. Partial serpent grip.

anant_kalasarpa.name: Anant Kala Sarpa (Rahu in 1st)
anant_kalasarpa.description: Kala Sarpa with Rahu in 1st house. Infinite serpent affecting self.

kulik_kalasarpa.name: Kulik Kala Sarpa (Rahu in 2nd)
kulik_kalasarpa.description: Kala Sarpa with Rahu in 2nd house. Serpent affecting wealth and speech.

vasuki_kalasarpa.name: Vasuki Kala Sarpa (Rahu in 3rd)
vasuki_kalasarpa.description: Kala Sarpa with Rahu in 3rd house. King serpent affecting siblings and courage.

shankpal_kalasarpa.name: Shankpal Kala Sarpa (Rahu in 4th)
shankpal_kalasarpa.description: Kala Sarpa with Rahu in 4th house. Conch serpent affecting home and mother.

padma_kalasarpa.name: Padma Kala Sarpa (Rahu in 5th)
padma_kalasarpa.description: Kala Sarpa with Rahu in 5th house. Lotus serpent affecting children and intelligence.

mahapadma_kalasarpa.name: Mahapadma Kala Sarpa (Rahu in 6th)
mahapadma_kalasarpa.description: Kala Sarpa with Rahu in 6th house. Great lotus serpent affecting enemies and health.

takshak_kalasarpa.name: Takshak Kala Sarpa (Rahu in 7th)
takshak_kalasarpa.description: Kala Sarpa with Rahu in 7th house. Powerful serpent affecting marriage.

karkotak_kalasarpa.name: Karkotak Kala Sarpa (Rahu in 8th)
karkotak_kalasarpa.description: Kala Sarpa with Rahu in 8th house. Serpent affecting longevity and transformation.

shankhchud_kalasarpa.name: Shankhchud Kala Sarpa (Rahu in 9th)
shankhchud_kalasarpa.description: Kala Sarpa with Rahu in 9th house. Conch-crested serpent affecting fortune.

ghatak_kalasarpa.name: Ghatak Kala Sarpa (Rahu in 10th)
ghatak_kalasarpa.description: Kala Sarpa with Rahu in 10th house. Striking serpent affecting career.

vishdhar_kalasarpa.name: Vishdhar Kala Sarpa (Rahu in 11th)
vishdhar_kalasarpa.description: Kala Sarpa with Rahu in 11th house. Poison-holder serpent affecting gains.

sheshnag_kalasarpa.name: Sheshnag Kala Sarpa (Rahu in 12th)
sheshnag_kalasarpa.description: Kala Sarpa with Rahu in 12th house. Divine serpent affecting liberation.

mukta_yoga.name: Mukta Yoga
mukta_yoga.description: All benefics in kendras, all malefics in 3, 6, 11. Liberation yoga.

yuga_yoga_four_kendras.name: Yuga Yoga (Four Kendras)
yuga_yoga_four_kendras.description: All four kendras occupied by benefics only. Era-defining yoga.

amrita_yoga.name: Amrita Yoga (Nectar)
amrita_yoga.description: Jupiter in 5th aspecting lagna lord, and lagna lord in trikona. Immortal fame.

kalanala_yoga.name: Kalanala Yoga (Time Fire)
kalanala_yoga.description: Mars in 7th, Saturn in 8th, and 4th lord afflicted. Fire of time - transformative.

vanchita_yoga.name: Vanchita Yoga
vanchita_yoga.description: 5th lord strong with 11th lord. Desires fulfilled yoga.

avayoga.name: Avayoga (Non-yoga)
avayoga.description: No planets in kendras or trikonas. Lack of support yoga.

duryoga.name: Duryoga (Bad Yoga)
duryoga.description: 10th lord in dusthana afflicted. Career difficulties.

maha_yoga.name: Maha Yoga (Great Yoga)
maha_yoga.description: Lagna lord, 9th lord, and 10th lord all strong in kendras. Triple greatness.

sarva_yoga.name: Sarva Yoga (Complete Yoga)
sarva_yoga.description: All kendra and trikona lords well-placed. Complete success.

uttama_yoga.name: Uttama Yoga (Supreme Yoga)
uttama_yoga.description: Lagna lord exalted in kendra aspected by Jupiter. Supreme success.

madhya_yoga.name: Madhya Yoga (Medium Yoga)
madhya_yoga.description: Lagna lord in own sign in kendra. Medium level success guaranteed.

adhama_yoga.name: Adhama Yoga (Low Yoga)
adhama_yoga.description: Lagna lord debilitated in dusthana afflicted. Low start but can improve.
